query: What recurring issues drive resolution inefficiency?

per_column.name: incident_category
per_column.rationale: The type of affected asset/system is a constitutive aspect of what an incident's inefficiency reason is about (what kind of thing failed).

per_column.name: failure_mode
per_column.rationale: How the thing failed is a core aspect of the reason an incident is inefficient to resolve; a genuine part of the concept.

per_column.name: issue_nature
per_column.rationale: Hardware/software/connectivity classification substantially overlaps with both incident_category (asset) and failure_mode (connectivity_failure, performance_degradation appear verbatim), largely restating those facets rather than adding a distinct aspect.

per_column.name: requires_physical_intervention
per_column.rationale: Whether physical action is needed is an aspect of what makes resolution inefficient (drives handling effort), a legitimate constitutive facet.

per_column.name: recurrence_signal
per_column.rationale: Recurrence is directly named in the query ('recurring issues') and is a constitutive aspect of the inefficiency reason.

per_column.name: scope_context
per_column.rationale: The breadth/impact scope (individual vs shared/infrastructure) is an aspect of the incident that shapes resolution effort; a valid facet, though it partly correlates with incident_category.

per_column.name: self_resolved_by_assignee
per_column.rationale: This describes a resolution OUTCOME/handling behavior, not a constitutive aspect of the inefficiency reason itself; it is an effect/observable predictor rather than a part-of facet.

per_column.name: urgency_signal
per_column.rationale: Urgency/priority is an attribute governing prioritization (already present as priority) rather than a constitutive part of why resolution is inefficient; it is an external driver, not a facet of the reason.

judge.rationale: Several columns are genuine part-of facets of the inefficiency-reason concept (what failed, how it failed, physical intervention, recurrence, scope). However mutual exclusivity is weakened: issue_nature largely restates incident_category and failure_mode (sharing connectivity_failure and performance_degradation values), and scope_context correlates with incident_category. Two columns are not facets at all: self_resolved_by_assignee is a resolution outcome and urgency_signal is an external prioritization driver, both effects/predictors rather than constitutive aspects. Exhaustiveness is moderate: the retained facets cover asset, failure mode, physicality, recurrence, and scope, but overlaps mean effective distinct coverage is thinner than the column count suggests.
